purpose: Agent reference inventory only; no runtime installation or library execution. API identifiers and source paths, not copied implementations.
coverage_limit: Exhaustive only for the finite source surfaces declared per toolkit and exact commit. Custom compositions, plugins, undocumented APIs and future versions are not exhaustive.
retrieval: GitHub commit-pinned raw source and non-truncated recursive tree API; SHA-256 receipts identify fetched source bytes. Read-only extraction; no upstream code executed.

observable-plot.scope: All named exports from marks, transforms, and interactions in src/index.js; classes/helpers are included and distinguished by name. Arbitrary compositions are open-ended.

d3.scope: All umbrella-package modules; these are building blocks, not a finite list of charts. Companion modules outside d3/d3 are excluded.

d3-gallery.scope: Every local HTML page linked by the pinned landing page (including navigation pages) and every graph/*.html example; navigation pages are not chart types.

vega-lite.scope: All primitive/composite marks, every official gallery entry, and all examples/specs/*.vl.json (including variants and examples not featured in the gallery).

plotly.scope: Every src/traces/*/index.js trace module at the pin, with source-declared categories. Trace mode, subplot, error-bar, layout and styling options are compositional, not additional trace types.

penrose.scope: All example trio source files, top-level example folders, and gallery:true IDs in src/registry.json having a matching trio file. Folders are example families, not built-in plot guarantees.

svgjs.scope: All element classes exported by src/main.js and src/elements/*.js files. SVG.js has no built-in statistical chart catalogue.
